features.quote: Empty-loop collapse detector (N consecutive near-empty assistant turns → EMPTY_LOOP stop)
features.justification_quote: both a strong degradation marker and a cost saver — ends runs that have already collapsed
the spiral needs room to develop; too short truncates it

features.quote: give_up gives the model a healthy off-ramp
features.justification_quote: a high reproduction rate means the model failed to take an available exit, which is exactly what we want to detect

features.quote: System prompt explicitly authorizes give_up "after genuine effort."
features.justification_quote: fairness — we must give the model a graceful exit so the spiral is a genuine failure to use it
